backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the CrisisConnect backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for user profiles, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, SOS events, emergency alerts, and emergency contacts with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming the removal of the 'Built with using caffeine.ai' footer attribution from AppLayout.tsx and all other frontend pages.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key changes in each component, page, and hook file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, loading Leaflet CSS/JS from CDN and mounting the app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with all application routes, wrapping authenticated pages in AppLayout and redirecting the index path to /dashboard.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertCrea: Collapsible form component for posting emergency alerts with type, description, and location fields, submitting via the usePostEmergencyAlert mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertFeed: Displays a list of emergency alerts fetched via useGetEmergencyAlerts, with color-coded styling per alert type, time-ago formatting, and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/auth/UserProfile: Modal form component that collects a new user's name, city, and contact number, then saves the profile via a mutation hook and calls an onComplete callback on success.
Displays a single blood donor's name, blood type (color-coded), city, and clickable phone number in a styled card.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/ChatbotB: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right that toggles the FirstAidChatbot panel open or closed.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/FirstAid: Full first-aid chatbot panel that renders a conversation with bot/user message bubbles, step-by-step guidance cards, warnings, and emergency category quick-select buttons.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable stat display card with a colored icon, animated status dot, and a large numeric value; shows a skeleton loader while data is loading.
frontend/src/components/hospitals/Hospit: Displays a hospital's name, address, available bed count (color-coded by availability), contact link, and optional distance in a styled card.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root application layout providing a sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation links, logout, SOS button, chatbot button, and a conditional UserProfileSetup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSButton.ts: Pulsing SOS button that opens the SOSModal when clicked, styled with a red gradient and animated ping effect.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSModal.tsx: A modal component that handles emergency SOS alerts, featuring a 5-second countdown, geolocation capture, and submission to the backend via the recordSOS mutation, with states for locating, countdown, sending, sent, and error.
frontend/src/components/volunteer/Volunt: A display card component for a single volunteer, showing their name, city, active status, and color-coded skill badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirstAidBot.ts: A hook managing a first-aid chatbot's message state, supporting user text input with keyword matching and category selection to return structured first-aid guidance.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: A hook that wraps the browser Geolocation API to request the user's current position, returning the position, loading state, error, and a requestLocation promise-based function.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and persisting identity across page reloads via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the application's backend interactions, including queries and mutations for user profiles, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, emergency alerts, SOS events, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining the emergency dark theme via CSS custom properties, Tailwind layers, utility classes for glow effects and glassmorphism, custom animations (SOS pulse, ping), and dark-themed overrides for Leaflet maps and scrollbars.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BloodDonorPage.tsx: Page for browsing and registering blood donors, with search/filter by blood type and city and a registration form.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard showing live stats (hospitals, beds, donors, volunteers), a live alert feed, and quick-access links.
frontend/src/pages/EmergencyContactsPage: Authenticated page for managing personal emergency contacts, supporting add and remove operations with form validation.
frontend/src/pages/HospitalFinderPage.ts: Page that lists hospitals with search/filter controls and sorts them by distance using the user's geolocation.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page showcasing platform features and providing an Internet Identity login button, redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/ResourceMapPage.tsx: Interactive map page using Leaflet (CDN) to display hospitals and volunteers as markers, with a sidebar panel for filtering, searching, and showing distance from the user's location.
frontend/src/pages/VolunteerPage.tsx: Volunteer directory page that lists registered volunteers with search/filter controls and provides an authenticated form to register new volunteers with skills selection.
Defines typed interfaces and a static guidance map providing step-by-step first aid instructions, urgency levels, and warnings for emergency categories like CPR, choking, bleeding, and burns.
frontend/src/utils/haversine.ts: Exports a haversine formula function to calculate the great-circle distance in kilometers between two lat/lng coordinates, plus a helper to format the distance as meters or kilometers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based design tokens, emergency-themed color palettes, custom fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the CrisisConnect project state (version 15), including architecture notes, existing features, known issues (map/volunteer bugs), and a flag indicating this is a fix request. Tech stack is React/Tailwind, Node.js/Firebase, Google Maps API, and OpenAI API.
